headline.text: L3 ML4 lost *8 hours* on a packaging code format issue — customer approved at 14:24, but multiple equipment problems followed.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 2 tunnel 2 required allergen re-clean after almond peels found on the belt — last update at 06:29 said it still needed more work. Sollich 3 ran out of caramel at 12:09, completed caustic wash, and restarted at 15:41.
per_plant_summary.L2: ML3 completed allergen deep clean with ATP sign-offs. Panning sorting machine flagged for cleaning after inconclusive swab tests. FFS and ML2 ran routine production with no breaks.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML4 was down from 08:32 until 14:24 waiting on customer approval for a 2-line code format, then hit equipment issues including a solidified chocolate hopper, loose nozzle bolts, and a damaged gondola belt. ML1 cleared multiple mold alarms and a dirty camera. Truffle line worked through warm chocolate, a twisted separator belt, and accumulation from bad pieces.

notes.text: Small man lift tagged out of order; HOJ scheduled to repair before Friday.
L2 conference room fridge thawed after leak. Encoder from ML3 borrowed for ML4 emergency repair — need 2 more expedited.
MF Matrix found 5 untracked caramel pallets in WIP boxes; inventory discrepancy under investigation with MRC.

resolved.title: Sollich 3 ran out of caramel at 12:09
resolved.summary: Cook times hit 50 minutes; operator drained reserve and started caustic wash to prevent longer downtime.
resolved.resolution: Caustic complete, new batches cooked, QA approved caramel at 15:34, line running at 15:41 — "Line is running" (William Beattie).

resolved.title: Sollich 3 MM3 printer frozen since 12:40
resolved.summary: Markem printer locked up mid-shift and wouldn't respond; discovered during restart prep.
resolved.resolution: Power cycled at 16:16 to reset — printer back online.

resolved.title: Conference room fridge leaking water
resolved.summary: Refrigerator door leaked water onto floor creating slip hazard in L2 caramel conference room.
resolved.resolution: Cleaned at 11:24 — "Laudia already cleaned up the leak" (Maria Caldera). Jorel noted fridge needs full thaw.

resolved.title: ML4 down 8 hours on packaging code format
resolved.summary: Line stopped at 08:32 when requested 3-line lot code wouldn't fit in the wrapper print area; customer approved 2-line format at 14:24 and line resumed.
resolved.resolution: Customer approved 2-line format at 14:24 — "this is the approved format, please keep lot code on second line" (Ira Robison). Line started second shift at 14:30.

resolved.title: Cavanna M30 sensor shutting down truffle wrapper
resolved.summary: Cavanna unit repeatedly stopped on M30 sensor fault, blocking flow wrap.
resolved.resolution: Chain tension adjusted and chain lubed at 08:01 — "Chain tension needed adjustment and the chain needed to be lubed" (Nathan Ruiz).

resolved.title: ML4 inclusion hopper piece installed backwards
resolved.summary: Depositor inclusion system wasn't sending cookies out; maintenance found hopper piece reversed during setup.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance identified backwards installation at 09:14 and corrected it; system functioning.

resolved.title: Truffle separator belt twisted on south side
resolved.summary: South separator belt twisted mid-shift, blocking product flow; needed maintenance support to fix.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 16:31 — "With the help of maintenance, we are able to trim the chocolate while we fixed the belt and got it moving again."

resolved.title: ML4 system crash blocking final pallet labels
resolved.summary: IT system issue prevented warehouse from generating final labels for finished goods pallets starting at 21:51.
resolved.resolution: IT resolved at 22:27 — "The incident with the system has been resolved, we started making the final labels normally" (Fredy Montalvan).

resolved.title: ML1 camera dirty causing mold alarm
resolved.summary: Mold inspection camera triggered alarm and stopped line at 22:29; QA and maintenance called.
resolved.resolution: Cleaned at 22:41 — "Camera was dirty, ml1 is back up and running" (Imperial).

needs_attention.title: Sollich 2 tunnel 2 allergen contamination
needs_attention.summary: Almond peels found on tunnel 2 belt at 05:12 during pre-shift inspection; re-clean started at 05:34 but Ebrima reported at 06:29 it still needed more thorough cleaning.
needs_attention.status: Re-clean in progress as of 06:29 — "Tunnel 2 still needs more thorough clean" (Ebrima Dibba). Last message at 06:29; no final sign-off posted.

needs_attention.title: Sollich 3 level 4 clean failed visual inspection
needs_attention.summary: QA visual inspection at 23:17 found area under separation table not clean to level 4 standard.
needs_attention.status: Failed at 23:17 with photo evidence. Angelica acknowledged at 23:18. No re-clean or pass posted by window close.

needs_attention.title: Panning sorting machine needs cleaning after inconclusive swab
needs_attention.summary: Swab tests on sorting machine came back inconclusive at 06:51; QA requested cleaning before loading product.
needs_attention.status: Cleaning requested at 06:51 from Alex Mendoza and Jeffrey Barney. No confirmation of cleaning completion or re-swab results posted.

needs_attention.title: L2 washroom and wall leaking, HVAC suspected
needs_attention.summary: Water leaks inside washroom and wet spots on entrance wall; maintenance suspects clogged HVAC units.
needs_attention.status: Reported to William Lopez and Dave Ruff at 04:33. Maintenance assessment given but no repair or resolution posted.

needs_attention.title: ML4 white chocolate solidified in depositor 4 hopper
needs_attention.summary: One-shot hopper chocolate completely solidified at 14:54 because mixer drive wasn't moved to correct position during setup.
needs_attention.status: Mixer drive repositioned and marked at 15:52, capture test run at 16:34. Depositing resumed but no confirmation chocolate fully cleared from hopper.

needs_attention.title: Truffle chocolate temp too high causing defects
needs_attention.summary: Chocolate running too warm at 15:49, causing issues at Cavanna end with doubles and accumulation; operators working to bring temp down.
needs_attention.status: Operators adjusting temp at 15:49, still seeing accumulation at 18:00. Victor reported improvements needed at 17:10 on low weights. No final resolution posted.

needs_attention.title: ML4 depositor 4 nozzle plate bolts all loose
needs_attention.summary: Only 3 of the nozzle plate bolts were tight on depositor 4 at 06:43; could cause weight variance and leaks.
needs_attention.status: Nathan tightened all bolts at 06:52. Capture tests run and weights brought into range, but root cause of loosening not identified.

needs_attention.title: ML4 gondola outfeed belt damaged
needs_attention.summary: Damaged belt found on gondola outfeed conveyor at 06:52 blocking line restart after capture test adjustments.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 06:52, Itzel confirmed "we are ready to start but we can't due to the damaged belt on the Gondola" at 06:59. No resolution posted in window.

needs_attention.title: ML1 buffer tank temp rising
needs_attention.summary: Buffer tank temperature flagged as going up at 05:45 during third shift checks.
needs_attention.status: Flagged at 05:45. Subsequent checks at 04:06 and 06:36 showed rollers condition but no temp resolution posted.
